[b]THE FORMATION OF THE THYREN-HYDRONIA ECONOMIC PACT[/b]

The sunlight of the late afternoon shines through the windows of the presidential office. It illuminates a very important document being carefully examined by president Kaplan Zorlu. The document is being presented to him by minister of defense Tosun Nejdet.

"Mr president, as you can see I have put together the terms for a treaty between us and the Kingdom of Thyren. I must urge you to put forth these terms, as we need allies. We can't just sit around and expect nothing to happen to us. We need support and this is the perfect opportunity to get some!"

"Thank you for bringing this to my attention Mr Nejdet. I will make sure to consider your request thoroughly." The president replies

"Thank you Mr president."

Later that day President Kaplan Zorlu notified Tosun Nejdet of his decision to present the terms of the treaty to the government of Thyren. The following letter was sent to the government of Thyren.

"Dear Kingdom of Thyren,
I am writing this letter to propose a potential economic alliance with your respected and powerful nation. Me and my government would like to extend an invitation to attend a meeting within our country to discuss the terms of this potential alliance, which we would like to name the "Thyren-Hydronia Economic Pact" or THEP for short. This alliance could be the first step towards creating a solid relationship between our two  nations. It could vastly increase our power in the region and improve both our economies greatly. I hope that you will accept this invitation so that our nations can accomplish great things together.

Yours sincerely, President Kaplan Zorlu of the Democratic Republic of United Hydronia"
